server.json.description: Computer-use MCP for Windows 10/11: 32 tools — screenshot, UIA, Chrome CDP, type/click/scroll, VBA.
server.json.name: io.github.Harusame64/desktop-touch-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to disable automatic action guards (reverts to v0.11.12 behavior).
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_AUTO_GUARD

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable MCP perception resources.
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_RESOURCES

environmentVariables.description: Idle ms before the WinEvent sidecar enters dormancy (default 60000).
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_IDLE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to keep the WinEvent sidecar always running (no auto-dormancy).
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_DORMANCY_DISABLE

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the JSONL diagnostic event log (issue #365 Phase 2).
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG_DISABLE

environmentVariables.description: Override path for the diagnostic event log.
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Size in bytes at which the diagnostic event log rolls over to diagnostic.log.1 (default 67108864 = 64 MiB). Two rolled generations are kept. Values below 1 MiB are raised to 1 MiB and values above 1 GiB are lowered to 1 GiB; anything that is not a positive whole number falls back to the default, so a typo cannot disable rotation in either direction.
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG_MAX_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to record window titles and title queries in clear in the diagnostic event log. Off by default: titles are recorded as a short hash plus their length, because a title can contain a file name, a mail subject, or a browser page title.
environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_RESOLVE_LOG_RAW
